description: Source code for the rlc_tx_tm_entity class implementing Transparent Mode (TM) RLC transmission entity, including SDU handling, PDU pulling, buffer state management, and metrics collection.

classes.name: rlc_tx_tm_entity
classes.description: Represents a Transparent Mode (TM) RLC transmission entity handling SDUs, PDUs, and buffer states.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs, queues them, and logs relevant metrics.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Logs a warning and metrics when an SDU discard is attempted.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Prepares and returns a PDU for transmission, handling SDU segmentation, metrics, and buffer recycling.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Triggers an update of the buffer state to the lower layer if not already pending.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Sends the current buffer state to the lower layer.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current buffer state including HOL timestamp and pending bytes.
